006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.Owning;
009
010import java.util.Objects;
011import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
012import java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool;
013import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
014
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
017
018/**
019 * Configuration for parallel constraint validation.
020 * <p>
021 * This class supports two modes:
022 * <ul>
023 * <li>Internal thread pool: Created via {@link #withThreads(int)}, shut down by
024 * {@link #close()}. Uses {@link ForkJoinPool} internally to handle nested
025 * parallelism without deadlock.</li>
026 * <li>External executor: Provided via {@link #withExecutor(ExecutorService)},
027 * NOT shut down by {@link #close()}</li>
028 * </ul>
029 * <p>
030 * Instances should be used with try-with-resources or explicitly closed after
031 * validation.
032 */
033public final class ParallelValidationConfig implements AutoCloseable {
034
035  /**
036   * Single-threaded sequential execution (default, current behavior).
037   * <p>
038   * This instance does not need to be closed.
039   */
040  @SuppressWarnings("resource")
041  @NonNull
042  public static final ParallelValidationConfig SEQUENTIAL = new ParallelValidationConfig(null, 1, false);
043
044  /**
045   * The executor service, lazily initialized if using internal pool.
046   * <p>
047   * Volatile is required for thread-safe lazy initialization.
048   */
049  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidUsingVolatile") // Required for thread-safe lazy initialization
050  @Nullable
051  private volatile ExecutorService executor;
052  private final int threadCount;
053  private final boolean ownsExecutor;
054
055  private ParallelValidationConfig(@Nullable ExecutorService executor, int threadCount, boolean ownsExecutor) {
056    this.executor = executor;
057    this.threadCount = threadCount;
058    this.ownsExecutor = ownsExecutor;
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Create configuration using an application-provided executor.
063   * <p>
064   * The executor is NOT shut down by {@link #close()}; the caller retains
065   * ownership.
066   * <p>
067   * The caller owns the returned configuration and is responsible for closing it.
068   *
069   * @param executor
070   *          the executor service to use for parallel tasks
071   * @return configuration using the provided executor
072   * @throws NullPointerException
073   *           if executor is null
074   */
075  @NonNull
076  @Owning
077  public static ParallelValidationConfig withExecutor(@NonNull ExecutorService executor) {
078    Objects.requireNonNull(executor, "executor must not be null");
079    return new ParallelValidationConfig(executor, 0, false);
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Create configuration that creates an internal thread pool.
084   * <p>
085   * The internal pool is shut down when {@link #close()} is called.
086   * <p>
087   * The caller owns the returned configuration and is responsible for closing it.
088   *
089   * @param threadCount
090   *          number of threads (must be &gt;= 1)
091   * @return configuration with internal thread pool
092   * @throws IllegalArgumentException
093   *           if threadCount &lt; 1
094   */
095  @NonNull
096  @Owning
097  public static ParallelValidationConfig withThreads(int threadCount) {
098    if (threadCount < 1) {
099      throw new IllegalArgumentException("threadCount must be at least 1, got: " + threadCount);
100    }
101    if (threadCount == 1) {
102      return SEQUENTIAL;
103    }
104    return new ParallelValidationConfig(null, threadCount, true);
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Check if parallel execution is enabled.
109   *
110   * @return true if using more than one thread
111   */
112  public boolean isParallel() {
113    return executor != null || threadCount > 1;
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Get the executor service, creating an internal pool if needed.
118   * <p>
119   * For internal pools, the executor is created lazily on first call.
120   *
121   * @return the executor service
122   * @throws IllegalStateException
123   *           if called on SEQUENTIAL config
124   */
125  @NonNull
126  public ExecutorService getExecutor() {
127    if (!isParallel()) {
128      throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot get executor for sequential configuration");
129    }
130    ExecutorService result = executor;
131    if (result == null) {
132      synchronized (this) {
133        result = executor;
134        if (result == null) {
135          // Use ForkJoinPool to avoid deadlock with nested parallelism.
136          // Fixed thread pools deadlock when all threads wait for children.
137          result = new ForkJoinPool(threadCount);
138          executor = result;
139        }
140      }
141    }
142    return Objects.requireNonNull(result, "Executor should not be null after initialization");
143  }
144
145  /**
146   * Shut down internal executor if one was created.
147   * <p>
148   * Does nothing if using an external executor or if no executor was created.
149   */
150  @Override
151  public void close() {
152    ExecutorService exec = executor;
153    if (ownsExecutor && exec != null) {
154      exec.shutdown();
155      try {
156        if (!exec.awaitTermination(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
157          exec.shutdownNow();
158        }
159      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") InterruptedException ex) {
160        exec.shutdownNow();
161        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
162      }
163    }
164  }
165}
